question: Does the public cast-once canonical source-geometry API make the frozen primary-center and fixed-center inference paths raw-byte identical throughout the complete 36-case ID-reference cohort?

hypothesis.candidate: Supplying one coherent canonical source bundle through CanonicalSourceGeometry removes center-path dependence without changing topology, source identity, query identity, or replay determinism.
hypothesis.prediction: After every validity gate passes, all 720 preregistered full-trace primary-versus-fixed pressure and WSS tensors are raw-byte identical.
hypothesis.falsifier: One or more raw-byte mismatches among the 720 full-trace tensors, provided every instrument-validity and primary-replay gate passes.
not_a_falsifier: a missing, timed-out, out-of-memory, or unreadable lane
a canonical construction, topology, query-prefix, source-storage, anchor-replay, or primary-replay failure
a changed cohort, resolution, precision, input hash, producer hash, reducer hash, or execution-source hash

intervention.construction: Promote raw selected geometry to float64, compute a physical area-weighted center, remove that center coherently from points and centroids, divide points and centroids by L_ref times model_reference_length, divide areas by the squared scale, retain unit normals and selected topology, then cast each completed field once to float32.

query_contract.coupled_query: S_K canonical trace centroids in source cell-identity order
query_contract.fixed_panel_Q: the first 2500 cell-identity rows of the one coupled S_K decode
query_contract.required_prefix_gate: For every K, the first 2500 selected cell IDs equal the independently reconstructed S_2500 identity prefix exactly; persisted prefix arrays must be exact slices of persisted coupled arrays.

registered_counts.deduplicated_summary_formula: 720 full-trace summaries plus 576 nonduplicate Q-prefix summaries for K greater than 2500

required: all four lane artifacts are present, readable, sidecar-verified, schema-exact, and uniquely cover the frozen modulo-4 cohort
all stable-input, producer, reducer, helper, geometry-manifest, anchor, and execution-source hashes match

the staged full execution-source manifest has its frozen hash, exactly enumerates every non-cache regular file below physicsnemo, every direct regular file in recipe src, and the one staged dataset YAML with no missing or extra files, and passes sha256sum verification
no symlink, __pycache__ directory, or .pyc file exists anywhere in the task-local execution source before Python import
the task-local execution source is the imported PhysicsNeMo and recipe source
canonical geometry is finite, correctly shaped, positive-area, unit-normal, topology-preserving, centered at positive zero, and scaled by positive one
the public canonical tensors are the authoritative encoded tensors without a private replacement
independent canonical construction replay is raw-byte exact
the primary encoded path replay is raw-byte exact for pressure and WSS on the coupled trace and its prefix
the Q panel is an exact persisted slice of the coupled S_K trace and preserves the frozen cell-identity prefix

the reducer same-byte verifies and directly loads the frozen job-305691 anchor NPZ, then all 120 tensor comparisons from the four overlapping K=2500 canaries replay that anchor exactly in both precisions

decision_rule.authority: The independently recomputed reducer result, not a lane exit code or producer summary, controls the cohort outcome.

pass.criterion: Every validity gate and every one of the 720 full-trace primary-versus-fixed raw-byte comparisons passes.

refuted.criterion: Every validity gate passes and at least one of the 720 full-trace primary-versus-fixed raw-byte comparisons mismatches.

invalid.criterion: A readable artifact or a recomputed validity contract fails.

incomplete.criterion: One or more required lane artifacts are absent, unreadable, timed out, or otherwise unavailable.

four_canary_anchor.role: An exact overlap replay is an instrument-validity gate only; the four canaries do not license the 36-case conclusion by themselves.

launch_contract.runtime_task_path_basis: After proving that the logical task directory resolves exactly to the frozen physical task directory, derive every task-local input, lane output, reducer input/output, lock, marker, log, execution-source path, and PYTHONPATH entry from the physical /scratch path so the reducer's component-wise O_NOFOLLOW walk encounters no symlinked parent.
launch_contract.execution_source_manifest_inventory: all non-cache regular files recursively below physicsnemo, all non-cache regular files directly below recipe src, and recipe datasets/drivaer_ml_surface.yaml; no unrelated recipe files
launch_contract.dataset_yaml_staging_source: the launch bundle frozen_inputs/drivaer_ml_surface.yaml artifact with SHA-256 a86a23fb5ae87a400f6b326c597c1a1358429c020628197bd77d2465f1fabed3, not the dirty working-tree YAML
launch_contract.allocation: one whole AGA node with four GB300 GPUs for at most two hours
launch_contract.parallelism: four concurrent physical-/scratch venv Python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc_per_node=1 lanes, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 0 through 3, eight CPU threads per lane

limitations: This experiment tests center-path invariance of one public cast-once canonical geometry implementation; it does not establish surrogate accuracy.
It does not rerun or license H-QC, truth-relative error, force, endpoint, support, futility, eligibility, or mixed decisions.
It is limited to one frozen checkpoint, 36 cases, five nested source resolutions, two precision contexts, one trace contract, and the recorded software and input hashes.
A pass does not establish all-case, all-mesh, all-hardware, training-time, architectural, or out-of-distribution generality.
A refutation rejects this implementation candidate under the frozen contract; it does not prove that no canonical geometry repair can work.
The 1296 deduplicated summaries and 1440 emitted records are deterministic views of 720 licensing tensors, not independent statistical observations.

post_result_actions.after_valid_pass: Freeze and run a separate exact historical K=10000 truth replay, then preregister a target-using accuracy and noninferiority experiment. Do not infer accuracy or H-QC eligibility from this validity pass.
post_result_actions.after_valid_refutation: Preserve the refutation and use any private derived-geometry intervention only as a newly registered diagnostic; it cannot license the public implementation.
post_result_actions.after_invalid_or_incomplete: Repair or complete the instrument without treating the attempted run as evidence for or against the candidate, then rerun under a newly frozen launch record if any executable or contract changes.
